deployments_detail.use: AI for rapid wafer defect root-cause analysis (improves yield); AI Promotion Division (est. 2018, ~300 people)

RTM (Real-Time Monitoring) AI judgment system that automates good/defective quality classification of high-precision wafers, replacing manual visual inspection by skilled engineers. Managed by SUMCO's AI Promotion Division (AI推進本部, set up 2018, ~300 staff). [In-house (AI推進本部)]

AI-driven wafer defect root-cause analysis and yield improvement: AI not only automates good/bad judgment but analyzes causes of defects from factory operating data to speed up quality improvement and production ramp. Part of a major multi-year AI/technology investment.
deployments_detail.value: Several hundred billion yen invested over 4-5 years (AI and related tech)

deployments_detail.use: Big-data analytics platform aggregating quality and process information for stage-by-stage production monitoring, real-time analysis and forecasting to strengthen commodity-segment competitiveness and accelerate advanced product development. [In-house]
DX Tools suite (BI tools, RPA robotic process automation, workflow systems) deployed across factories and indirect/back-office departments for business-process efficiency.

In-house 'factory dashboard' with real-time equipment monitoring/visualization, quantitative bottleneck identification and second-level timing analysis to reduce equipment variance and boost throughput on the flagship 300mm line (integrated with AGVs/cobots). [In-house (AI推進本部)]
deployments_detail.value: 10%+ productivity improvement, ~3 billion yen investment-suppression effect, ~4 billion yen/year profit creation on 300mm facility

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous mobile transport robots plus an integrated management system (stocker-to-stocker transport) introduced at SUMCO's Kyushu plant for factory logistics automation, integrated with production equipment. [CI Robotics]

Partnership with Shiga University's Data Science faculty on AI/data-science application: joint data analysis of real manufacturing-site data, monthly academic guidance using SUMCO's accumulated data, and data-science human-resource development. [Shiga University (Data Science)]

Comprehensive industry-academia-government collaboration with Saga University and AIST (産総研) applying AI to silicon-wafer manufacturing, notably anomaly detection of wafer manufacturing equipment and measurement-technology consulting, plus big/open data utilization. [Saga University; AIST (産総研)]
